title: TypeScript
tagline: Write rock-solid, self-documenting JavaScript with static types, generics, narrowing, and type-level programming.
description: Master TypeScript 5+ from strict compiler configuration and structural typing to discriminated unions, advanced generics, conditional/mapped types, and end-to-end API type safety.
whatYoullLearn: Configure strict tsconfig.json flags including strictNullChecks and noUncheckedIndexedAccess
Model domain states cleanly with discriminated unions, exhaustiveness checking, and narrowing
Write reusable generic functions, classes, and mapped/conditional utility types
Combine static TypeScript types with runtime schema validation at API boundaries

levelSummaries.Beginner: Primitive & object types, strict config, unions/intersections, functions, and interfaces vs type aliases.
levelSummaries.Intermediate: Type narrowing, discriminated unions, generics with constraints, utility types, and classes/modules.
levelSummaries.Advanced: Conditional types, infer, template literal types, variance, declaration files, and runtime boundary validation.

projectTitle: Type-Safe Full-Stack API Client & Schema Validation Kit
